reviewed_by: Codex focused dependency review for Mako 1.4.2
reason: Mako renders Alembic migration templates. Five collected migration tests cover the upgrade and downgrade path affected by the lockfile update.
exclusions: No frontend or native dependency changed, so those layers and Playwright are excluded. The PostgreSQL case requires NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL and skips when unavailable. Unrelated Python suites and full suites are excluded.
